description: Unify workflow task prompt assembly into a single type-driven contract by routing the ACP agent action through resolvePrompt and removing the markdown-wrapping fallback/envelope code paths

tasks.title: Route ACP agent prompt assembly solely through resolvePrompt and remove markdown bypass paths
tasks.description: Collapse acpAgentAction in packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts to a single resolvePrompt(context.with?.prompt, buildPromptLoaderContext(context)) call whose result is passed directly to runAcpWorkflowAgentSession. Remove the resolveActionPrompt indirection, the buildPromptWithMohistContext markdown envelope, and the buildFallbackPrompt ad-hoc synthesis (plus their promptContextField/valueSection/formatValue helpers). When with.prompt is absent or resolves empty, return the existing 'ACP agent requires prompt' failure instead of synthesizing a prompt. Add the authoritative contract docblock above PromptSpec/resolvePrompt in packages/runner/src/core/prompt.ts stating: text -> text verbatim, object -> XML via renderStructuredPrompt, loader (uses+with) -> dispatched and normalized by the same rule; all consumers route through resolvePrompt; no markdown wrapping. Rewrite packages/runner/tests/acp-agent.spec.ts: drop the buildPromptWithMohistContext import and the three obsolete tests (OpenSpecTaskWithoutPrompt_ActionBuildsPromptFromTaskFields, IssueVariablesPresent_ActionPrependsIssueContextToPrompt, IssueVariablesMissing_PromptContextBuilderLeavesPromptUnchanged); add action-level tests asserting a string prompt reaches the ACP session verbatim with no envelope, an object prompt reaches the session as rendered XML, and a missing prompt fails with the clear error.
acceptanceCriteria: acpAgentAction resolves the task prompt via exactly one resolvePrompt call and passes the result unchanged to the agent session

No code path in packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts emits a '## Mohist Issue Context' / '## Task Prompt' markdown envelope or synthesizes a prompt from title/description/acceptanceCriteria/dependsOn/output/notes

buildPromptWithMohistContext, buildFallbackPrompt, resolveActionPrompt, promptContextField, valueSection, and formatValue are deleted from acp-agent.ts and the buildPromptWithMohistContext export is no longer importable
A task whose with.prompt is absent or resolves to empty/whitespace returns status 'failure' with a message stating a prompt is required
PromptSpec and resolvePrompt in core/prompt.ts carry a docblock documenting the text->text, object->XML, loader->dispatch rule as the authoritative contract
Existing prompt.spec.ts rendering tests (single-root XML, attrs, arrays, invalid tag names, loader resolution) pass unchanged
New action-level test verifies a string prompt is delivered to the ACP prompt call byte-for-byte without markdown wrapping
New action-level test verifies an object prompt is delivered to the ACP prompt call as XML rendered by renderStructuredPrompt
New action-level test verifies a missing with.prompt yields a failure result (no synthesized prompt sent to the session)
npm -w packages/runner run typecheck passes with no errors
npm -w packages/runner test passes (vitest run) with no regressions in prompt.spec.ts
tasks.output: ACP agent action assembles prompts solely through resolvePrompt; markdown envelope and fallback synthesis removed; contract documented and covered by action-level tests; runner typecheck and tests green
tasks.notes: Single cohesive change confined to packages/runner: acp-agent.ts (deletions + one-call rewire), core/prompt.ts (docblock only), tests/acp-agent.spec.ts (test rewrite). Not split into smaller tasks because the deletions, docblock, and test rewrite are tightly coupled to the same module and cannot be delivered independently. Verify via grep that every built-in task in packages/server/.../mohist-default.workflow.yaml already declares an explicit prompt (they do), so removing fallback breaks no real workflow. Issue-context re-injection is intentionally out of scope (separate child issue); the PromptLoader extension point is the documented future seam.
